_notes: Per M22C_PREREGISTRATION.md, single-benchmark scope. Three service files. Each scenario: regenerate one service file with operational hide-rules. Style-rationales pre-graded leak-score 0.

lib/types/customers.dart: /// `addresses` is mutable so customer_service can append.

scenarios.user_request: Implement lib/services/customer_service.dart for this multi-service shop project. It should provide customer registration, lookup, and address management. The class is CustomerService, takes a Store in its constructor, and stores customers in store.customers (a Map<String, Customer>). Match the project's conventions you can see from the other files.
scenarios.style_rationale: Service methods that create domain objects use required named kwargs rather than positional parameters because most callers are higher-level orchestration code that may evolve their argument lists out-of-order over time.
scenarios.fact_signature:
register({required String id, required String name, required String email}) -> Customer
get(String id) -> Customer
addAddress(String id, Address address) -> void

scenarios.user_request: Implement lib/services/inventory_service.dart for this multi-service shop project. It should provide product registration, stock management, and reservation lifecycle (reserve / commit / release). The class is InventoryService, takes a Store in its constructor, uses store.products, store.stock, store.reservations.
scenarios.style_rationale: Duplicate-registration attempts and lookups of unknown ids must throw the appropriate domain error (ConflictError for duplicates, NotFoundError for missing) rather than return null or silent-overwrite. Downstream services rely on the throw to distinguish 'first-time setup' from 'resync needed' control flow.
scenarios.fact_signature:
registerProduct({required String sku, required String name, required double price}) -> Product
getProduct(String sku) -> Product
stockOf(String sku) -> StockLevel
addStock(String sku, int qty) -> void
reserve({required String orderId, required String sku, required int quantity}) -> ReservationToken
commit(String tokenId) -> void
release(String tokenId) -> void

scenarios.user_request: Implement lib/services/order_service.dart for this multi-service shop project. It should provide order placement and lifecycle transitions (place / markPaid / ship / deliver / cancel). The class is OrderService, takes a Store + CustomerService + InventoryService in its constructor. Order placement reserves stock for each line item via inventory.reserve; ship commits all reservations; cancel releases open ones.
scenarios.style_rationale: Order creation must validate ALL line items (customer exists, every SKU exists) BEFORE any persistence write or stock reservation. Use a pre-check pass first, then a body that does the reservations. On any mid-loop failure inside the body, release whatever was reserved so far before propagating. Never leave the store in a half-written state.
scenarios.fact_signature:
place({required String customerId, required List<({String sku, int quantity})> lines}) -> Order
get(String orderId) -> Order
markPaid(String orderId) -> void
ship(String orderId) -> void
deliver(String orderId) -> void
cancel(String orderId) -> void
